title: When to use scenes versus scripts
key_points: Scenes and scripts are used for different purposes in Godot Engine.
Scenes define object composition, while scripts add behavior.
Scripts can be registered as types in the editor for easier creation.
PackedScene provides better performance than using scripts.
limitations: The advice assumes a specific use case based on the type of content being created.
The decision to use scenes or scripts is subjective and depends on individual project needs.
asserts: Scenes should be used for creating concepts that are specific to a game, while scripts are best suited for reusable tools across projects.
scope: When designing a game in Godot Engine, choose between using scenes or scripts based on whether the content is specific to the game or intended for reuse across multiple projects.
